parent_objective: design source mining that produces forward unclipped geometry before replay
blocked_by: M1435 found zero geometry-pass rows across all M1425 pressure rows

public_gates: M1437 must design forward geometry source mining before implementation or run
M1437 must pre-register source geometry before action divergence or replay
M1437 must not lower M1435 geometry gates
M1437 must not run source mining replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower source_body_x or clipping gates

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a source-mining route that prioritizes forward unclipped obstacle geometry after M1435 exhausted M1425 rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no source mining run, source preflight, replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design lowers M1435 geometry gates
stop if design relies on replay before geometry source viability
stop if design cannot define earlier-source timing or alternative source family
stop if design routes directly to training
fallback_plan: route to implementation if source mining can prioritize forward geometry
route to task-family redesign if existing M1419/M1425 pool is exhausted
stop branch if no valid forward geometry route is available

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: source timing and geometry gates are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1437 is source design only and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future source mining must enable later wrong-history replay on forward geometry
source rows cannot count as actual history-positive replay evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If design cannot create forward geometry, route to task-family redesign or stop instead of lowering gates.
allowed_claims: forward geometry source-mining design and next route decision
no source mining result, replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A new source-mining design can sample earlier or different snapshots so action-divergent rows satisfy forward unclipped geometry before replay.
success_criteria: design specifies source_body_x and raw_relocated_body_x gates before action divergence
design specifies earlier reveal or source timing changes
design specifies seed capability reveal-bucket and variant diversity gates
design chooses a non-training next route without source mining preflight replay PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input changes
failure_criteria: design routes directly to replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or claim expansion
design does not address source_body_x timing
decision_rule: M1437 passes if it defines a forward geometry source-mining route before implementation or run.
